verdict.rationale: Terraform exposes AI-drivable interfaces via a documented, machine-readable CLI (`-json` plan/show/validate output, verified working headlessly in probes) and an official MCP server that HashiCorp explicitly built to give AI models real-time access to Terraform docs/modules/policies (confirmed via a live JSON-RPC handshake). However, there is no traditional documented public REST/OpenAPI API (openapi.json 404, no llms.txt), so agentic access is mediated through CLI/MCP rather than a conventional API surface.
